headline: Frontier dynamics in quantum circuits, states, and semigroups
summary: Today's research spans fundamental quantum dynamics, including prethermalization bounds, depth-1 unitary expanders, and regularisation properties of Gaussian semigroups. Alongside theoretical advances in quantum automata and verifiable shallow circuit sampling, applied work explores quantum moving averages for financial forecasting.

themes.title: Quantum Dynamics and Prethermalization
themes.body: Investigations into foundational limits of quantum relaxation reveal that scale separation alone does not guarantee prethermalization, with lifetimes bounded by the Loschmidt echo and observable-dependent plateaus.

themes.title: Circuits, Expanders, and Advantage
themes.body: New constructions yield constant-degree and constant-gap quantum expanders via depth-1 1D circuits, while other work demonstrates verifiable quantum sampling advantages in extremely low circuit depth.

themes.title: Algebraic Semigroups, Automata, and Applications
themes.body: Studies explore the algebraic properties of Gaussian quantum Markov semigroups, memory effects in symmetric quantum automata, and quantum weighted moving averages for financial limit order book predictions.

connections.body: Both papers utilize constant-depth or structured circuit designs to analyze complexity and state behavior on quantum systems.
